scientific_limitations_and_integrity.domain: Smooth complex dimension n >= 4 even complete intersections of n+1 split quadrics in P^(2n+1) with free sign involution; arbitrary special/singular/non-free members excluded.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limit: No computation of higher integral cohomology; no independent priority or mathematical audit certification. The proof uses classical integral Lefschetz, Cartan–Leray, and the exponential sequence.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.originating_source_role: May 2026 Brauer work motivates comparing distinct types of Enriques manifolds; the explicit quadric examples were already exhibited in September 2024.

title: Brauer vanishing for split-quadric Enriques quotients in every even dimension at least four
